set.body: On Explore (.explore-stage) and Results (.plot-pane) keyboard focus rings the pane/stage edge AND the canvas cursor; the boards and the shared-shell rule ('while focused, only its cursor item draws the accent ring') ring only the cursor. Treat canvas panes like composite panes (S5's pane-composite / no-cursor model): no edge ring while the canvas shows its cursor ring; the edge ring only for a canvas with no cursor item. Keep :keyboard-within (S24) as the keyboard gate. A11yRenderSuite must still count canvas stops as drawn differently (simulate honestly). Remove the PARITY pane-edge bullet. Owner decision 2026-10-15 (close-out review). Epic bd-01M4R9BYCYAZAPHYSK79MVWHKW.
set.title: [S28] Canvas panes ring only the cursor under keyboard focus (tickets 14, 28)
